Permalink: Node.js Security Team Membership Policy
The Node.js Security Team has access to security-sensitive issues and patches that aren't appropriate for public availability.
The policy for inclusion is as follows:
All members of @nodejs/TSC have access to private security reports and private patches.
Members of the @nodejs/releasers team have access to private security patches in order to produce releases.
